sutta: next is 52.4 for one occasion available available and the verbal maha mogalana were dwelling at saketa in the thorn bush grove then in the evening the vampire sariputta and the vulnerable emerged from seclusion approached the verbal anuruda and exchanged greetings with him when they had concluded their greetings and cordial talk they sat down to one side and the verbal sarikuta said to the rumble anuruddha friend and ruda what are the things that a man who is a trainee should enter and dwell in and he said friends a man who is a trainee should enter and dwell in the four intense states of recollection sati patana what for dear friend among dwells contemplating the body in the body this body in the body now brother monk has just informed me and that the verbal penisa rules contemplation is interpretation as well as contemplating the body in and of itself right just contemplating the body in and of itself that means in the body not outside of the body just like what i said that not among thoughts and all that but centered on the body and focus on the body it was contributing feelings in and of itself mind in and of itself dharma in and of itself garden clearly aware recollected having removed covetousness and grief in regard to the world among who is a trainee should enter and dwell in these four and ten states of recollection then the nexuta is similar as akita
